# feat(admin): preview and "open in the builder" actions in the edit view

<!-- bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#47 as read with gh issue view on 2026-10-24: the input of micelio-plugin-core-47.md -->

Part of #62.

## Why

Decision 2: the builder opens from a button in the Content Manager's edit view. Strapi 5 gives a plugin `addDocumentAction`, `addDocumentHeaderAction` and `addEditViewSidePanel`; the native Publish cannot be removed, so the server's refusal plus a notification is the pattern (constraints table of the scope).

## What to build

- Header action "Preview" (opens `/plugins/micelio/preview/...`, disabled with unsaved changes and a tooltip that says so) and, in phase 2, "Open in the builder".
- The editorial side panel (#23) gains the cost line ("42 kB of 60 kB") and the last measurement time.
- `config.preview.handler` still points at the full-screen preview route for Strapi's own "Open preview" shortcut.

## Requirements

- Only for content types with a dynamic zone of blocks and a site.
- Both locales; the actions have accessible names.
- `feat` → MINOR.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The browser suite sees the header action on a page and not on a category; clicking it opens the preview page for that document.
- [ ] With unsaved changes the action is disabled and explains why.
- [ ] Verified by the maintainer on the plugin's Docker Compose (`compose.dev.yml`: clean Strapi with the plugin, PostgreSQL and the frontend image), following the steps the PR lists under Tests.

## Delivery

The agent never pushes on its own. When the maintainer says the manual test on Docker is done, the agent gives the `git add` and `git commit -s` commands with the message (conventional prefix, English, `Co-Authored-By:` trailer); once the maintainer confirms the commit, the agent pushes the branch and opens the PR (REST), with the Docker steps under Tests and `Refs`/`Closes` to this issue. The maintainer reviews the whole diff before merging (standard, sections 11 and 13).
